P_x49a.registered: GROUNDS: (1) THE RAW-COLLAPSE ASYMMETRY (design-time reconnaissance of committed rows): the warm ticks are RAW collapses (anneal_s125 r1 0.124, walk_cons_s125 r1 -0.055; sibling anneal_s725 r1 -0.010; the walk's s100/s700 hover at 0.15-0.16) — the swap's s125 raw r1 is 0.494, mid-band, on a smooth descent whose deeper raw dips sit elsewhere (swap_s250 0.263; swap_s30 -0.041 out-of-band). A residual dip without a raw collapse is a different object than the warm tick. (2) COLD ARMS HAVE NEVER TICKED: e343's install path was near-perfectly coherent at its transient, decorrelating only as an upper-reach TREND; e344's swap scored coherent-ABOVE arm-level; no cold arm has shown an elementary event — only trends. (3) THE STAR IS TREND-CARRIED: all three edges positive (0.667/0.723/0.486) is the mechanical signature of sequences sharing a monotone decline with step, not of a shared tick; the exclusion test will show r(swap,anneal) survives s125's removal. (4) THE LINE ITSELF: I expect resid(swap_s125) negative (mid-descent) but SHORT of 0.5x the warm ticks — priced near 50/50 from the committed rows' geometry; the coin lands warm-bound in my read. SHAPE PREDICTIONS: dossier — anneal LEVEL-SHIFT (before ~+0.04 -> after ~-0.25, persists to s275); walk POINT-ANOMALY-leaning with late healing (s250-s275 back positive); the swap's own most-negative in-band step is NOT 125 (expect s250-class); the raw-collapse census finds the anneal sibling at s725. FALSIFIER: resid(swap_s125) <= -(0.5*min-warm) fires PHASE-LOCKED and I lose; the warm top-2 rank failing fires NO-EVENT (nobody's read); either warm arm grading EVENT upgrades the tick toward an elementary unit against my LEVEL-SHIFT read.
